Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2021 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of COST.
Our gross margin expanded by 47 basis points to 39.3%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2021.
Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 148 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
Thank you for the question. We generated $8.0 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Second question - Analyst:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
We expect revenues to grow approximately 8% to 22% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
